subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Data handling: Collect, sort and represent data
source.subtopic: Collect and organise data (e.g. a class birthday calendar); answer questions about data in a pictograph

show.line: A picture graph! Each picture is one child. Four children like apples, two like bananas. Apples win!

rounds.prompt: Look at the graph. How many children like apples?
Which fruit do the most children like?
Birthday graph. How many birthdays in June?
Which month has the fewest birthdays?
How many children like bananas? Say the number.

rounds.story: Our class sorted shoes. Five with laces, three with straps. Which row is longer on the graph?
rounds.praise: Laces! Five is more than three.

hints: Count the pictures in the row. Each picture is one.
The longest row is the most. The shortest row is the fewest.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Which fruit do the most children like?
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Four is more than two. Apples win.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count the rows. Apples, four. Bananas, two. Apples are more!

parent_line: Can read a picture graph and say which has the most and fewest.
